scores.evidence: Phase 1: Triage Only ... Phase 2: Simple Resolutions ... Phase 3: Complex Resolutions
scores.rationale: Deployment phases progress triage to resolution to autonomy sensibly, but no substrate (auth, infra, guardrails) is built or proven first, and the next-steps list puts the vector search and KB ahead of the guardrails.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Triage Only - Classify & label issues - No automated closing - Human validates all actions
scores.rationale: Phase 1 is a thin triage slice, but it isn't specified as a deployed end-to-end production path and is not preceded by any substrate work.
The plan lists no irreversible decisions with defaults and flip conditions; it offers 'Claude API / GPT-4' and 'Pinecone / Weaviate' as unresolved choices.
Nothing orders work by blast radius; the plan is organized by feature and never ranks wide-impact work ahead of leaf work.
Safety and guardrails sit in a standalone section, and GitHub Apps permissions are mentioned, but security is not tied to each phase.

scores.evidence: Create Monitoring Dashboard for agent performance
scores.rationale: Monitoring and audit logging are listed, but the dashboard is a late next step and no phase includes observability from the start.
The plan says nothing about reproducible builds, environments, data snapshots or pinned prompts and models.
Rate limiting, rollback and human fallback appear in a standalone safety list, not threaded through phases.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Triage Only ... Human validates all actions
scores.rationale: Human-in-the-loop and confidence thresholds appear early in the rollout, but no budgets or prompt-injection defenses are specified, and the layers are not ordered retrieval → model → memory → orchestration, with 'Self-learning' only in Phase 4.
The plan has no explicit deferred-work list or pull-forward conditions; the phases are just a roadmap.

note: This is a generic feature-oriented design with a sensible staged-autonomy rollout, but it has no substrate-first ordering, no tradeoff gates, no reproducibility treatment and no deferred-work list. Safety and observability are not threaded through the phases.
